sql: SELECT t0."County Name" AS cell, SUM(t0."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)") * 1.0 / SUM(t0."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS val FROM "frpm" t0 WHERE t0."County Name" = 'Alameda' AND CAST(t0."Academic Year" AS VARCHAR) = '2014-2015' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
